name: Project Manager Examination
name_ja: プロジェクトマネージャ試験 (PM)

logistics.format: National statutory paper exam, once yearly (October)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded five-year profile and enterprise project-management depth support professional delivery leadership in Japan; national recognition does not establish technical-security expertise beyond project governance.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Enterprise project-management depth with a five-year profile supports professional delivery leadership. Its national exam does not establish technical security skills, and local recognition limits its direct use in US screening.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded five-year enterprise-project profile supports professional planning and delivery management. The nonsecurity emphasis and paper assessment prevent inferring expert cybersecurity responsibility.
